changelog.summary: Binds exact strategist and search artifacts and adds executable optional search-to-content-to-page draft handoff checks with approved-opportunity and claim gates.
Adds executable strategist/search artifact checks, worked examples, an action ledger and repeat-run method, and separates technical SEO from buyer-question mapping.
Adds a saved nine-check setup checklist with evidence references for Builder chat and the Playbook screen.
Adds a chat-led Website Growth team proposal with two required Crew roles, typed handoffs, a baseline-first path, and a manual test before recurrence.

title: Website Growth Loop
description: Help a newly launched website attract more relevant visitors by coordinating a growth strategist and search specialist, then extending to content and measurement when ready.
setup_prompt: Use Website Growth Loop as a proposal. Inspect this Automation and my existing Crews first. Ask for the website, offer, audience, primary visitor action, and measurement choice only where missing. Propose which Crews to reuse or create, their access, the handoffs, a bounded first run, and a goal metric. After I review the concrete proposal, set it up through Builder tools and verify each step. Do not create agents, enable recurrence, publish pages, or send outreach merely because I selected this Playbook.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized canonical website URL or page export
Metric, source, baseline or baseline-first decision
Manual-only or reviewed schedule and timezone

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create an approved specialist with an idempotency key and workflow-bound Crew step

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Read an authorized Crew artifact through a checked workflow alias

recommended_tools.name: Search Console connection or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Provide authorized page and query evidence when available

recommended_tools.name: Website analytics connection or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Measure useful visitors and conversion actions after a valid baseline

pulse_focus.label: Website growth progress
focus_areas: Whether shipped work serves the target buyer and useful visitor action
Evidence quality and comparability of traffic signals
review_when: The site or offer changes, an action ships, or comparable data becomes available

outputs: Reviewed Crew roster and access map
Versioned growth brief and search opportunity handoff
Website Growth dashboard with evidence and open questions
